ko.title: 한자 · 중급 700
ko.description:
교육용 기초 한자 1,800자 중 중급 단계 700자입니다. 초급 다음으로 일반 한자어의 이해를 넓히는 글자를 익힙니다. 한국어기초사전의 수준별 어휘에 나타나는 정도를 참고한 앱 자체 단계이며 공식 시험 급수가 아닙니다. 세 단계는 서로 중복되지 않습니다. 한국어 음훈 중심이며, 유의·반의 관계는 일부 뜻을 기준으로 합니다.

en-US.title: Hanja · Intermediate 700
en-US.description:
The next 700 of the 1,800 educational Hanja. Expand your understanding of general Korean compounds after the beginner set. These are app learning stages informed by the characters' coverage in level-tagged Korean Basic Dictionary entries, not official exam grades. The three stages do not overlap. Korean readings remain unchanged. Similar and opposite meanings refer to particular senses, not all uses of a character.

Sources: Unicode Unihan 17.0.0 (Unicode License v3); libhangul Hanja dictionary (BSD 3-Clause); National Institute of Korean Language, Korean Basic Dictionary XML (2026-06-19, CC BY-SA 2.0 KR). Dictionary materials have been adapted into learning cards; stage assignments and representative meanings are editorial choices. English and Japanese compound definitions reuse the dictionary's translations; Chinese definitions are converted to Taiwan Traditional orthography with OpenCC. ja.title: 韓国漢字 · 中級700
ja.description:
教育用基礎漢字1,800字のうち、初級に続く700字です。一般的な韓国語の漢字語への理解を広げます。 『韓国語基礎辞典』のレベル別語彙に含まれる度合いを参考にした、本アプリ独自の学習段階です。公式の試験級ではありません。3段階の漢字は重複しません。韓国語の読みはそのまま保持し、類義・対義の関係は一部の意味を対象とします。

ko.title: 策
ko.description:
**채찍 책**

### 글자 정보

부수: 竹 · 대 죽 (118번)
총획수: 12획 (Unicode 기준)

### 활용 한자어

散策(산책) — 잠깐 쉬거나 건강을 위해 주변을 천천히 걷는 일.
[한국어기초사전 62506](https://krdict.korean.go.kr/kor/dicSearch/SearchView?ParaWordNo=62506)

政策(정책) — 정치적인 목적을 이루기 위한 방법.
[한국어기초사전 75623](https://krdict.korean.go.kr/kor/dicSearch/SearchView?ParaWordNo=75623)

對策(대책) — 어려운 상황을 이겨낼 수 있는 계획.
[한국어기초사전 14354](https://krdict.korean.go.kr/kor/dicSearch/SearchView?ParaWordNo=14354)

### 출처

음훈: libhangul · 부수/획수: Unicode Unihan. 한자어 풀이: 국립국어원 한국어기초사전(CC BY-SA 2.0 KR).

en-US.title: 策
en-US.description:
**whip**

### Korean meaning and reading

채찍 책

### Character details

Radical: 竹 · bamboo (No. 118)
Total strokes: 12 (Unicode reference)

### Korean words using this character

散策(산책) — An act of walking slowly around a nearby place for rest or health.
[Korean Basic Dictionary 62506](https://krdict.korean.go.kr/kor/dicSearch/SearchView?ParaWordNo=62506)

政策(정책) — A way to accomplish political aims.
[Korean Basic Dictionary 75623](https://krdict.korean.go.kr/kor/dicSearch/SearchView?ParaWordNo=75623)

對策(대책) — A plan that enables one to overcome a difficult situation.
[Korean Basic Dictionary 14354](https://krdict.korean.go.kr/kor/dicSearch/SearchView?ParaWordNo=14354)

### Sources

Korean meanings and readings: libhangul. Radicals and strokes: Unicode Unihan. Compound definitions and their translations: National Institute of Korean Language, Korean Basic Dictionary (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR).
